{{Quote|You're a little short for a smuggler.|A spacer, to Charl Sstena|<ref name="SWG:RtD" />}}
'''Charl Sstena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yukusu kenza keena!''"<br />"''Uh...Uncle Owen, this R2 unit has a bad motivator?|Charl Sstena rambling to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtD" />}}
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Charl Sstena helped sell [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]].<ref name="SWG:RtD" /> He then apparently survived the onslaught by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]] soon after.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Sstena worked as a smuggler, transporting goods outside the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine system]].<ref name="SWG:RtD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he was contracted to deliver goods to the [[Meatlumps]], a criminal gang on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for a Meatlump armorer contacted Sstena and arranged a rendezvous outside [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]]. However, the meeting point was attacked by some [[Ragtags]], a rival criminal group. After the spacer defeated the attackers, Charl Sstena was able to land and make the delivery.<ref name="SWG:RtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Charl Sstena was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Charl Sstena was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

Players who took part in the "Meatlump Themepark" could receive a quest where they must speak to Charl. When the player spoke to him, Charl would ramble on about [[Owen Lars/Legends|Uncle Owen]] and [[R5-D4/Legends|R5-D4]].<ref name="SWG:RtD" />
